Application Data.NAME: Petals & Blooms Florist
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Blossom Lane, Suite 100, Flower City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Petals & Blooms Florist specializes in providing a wide variety of fresh cut flowers and floral arrangements for all occasions, including weddings, birthdays, funerals, and corporate events. We also offer delivery services within the local area and provide additional products such as potted plants, gift baskets, and home decor items. Our shop is committed to sourcing flowers from sustainable growers and ensuring the highest quality in all our offerings. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer service and personalized consultations to meet our clients' specific needs and preferences.
